description: Four independent open-hold-release sequences on p1's group in one process, each followed by a fresh Database that reads the group: (a) release child, parent recordset and Database objects with no Close; (b) Close parent and Database, read the held child, Close the child, release; (c) release the Database then the parent recordset, read the held child, release it; (d) Close child, parent, Database in that order.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
